findings.evidence: Backend HEAD moved 1 commit past round-4's final HEAD (27d4d7712) to b5900ce52a24, title: 'fix(vitrine): « plus rien au-dessous » — la rotation tombait sur un acte VIDE ; et la roue reprend sa taille'. Diffstat: borne.blade.php only, 18 insertions/6 deletions. Content: (a) removes an empty 'ça vient de tomber' carousel slot when the wheel has zero recent winners (single-spin-per-session production reality), keeping the other 3 promo slots permanently displayed instead of rotating into a blank frame; (b) rescales several vmin-based font sizes (logo, promise, instruction, 'Scanne le QR code', sub-QR detail text) downward because a prior commit in this same drift chain (2577dbc4c) had grown the wheel's nominal size while also adding two text lines above it on the flex/elastic row, which paradoxically shrank the rendered wheel — this commit restores the intended visual balance. Verified by direct diff (`git diff 27d4d7712..b5900ce52 -- resources/views/admin/wheel/borne.blade.php | grep qr-logo`) that this commit does NOT touch `.qr-logo` (empty match) — confirmed separately from the direct grep/read in this round's item 1, which shows `.qr-logo{width:20%...}` unchanged on both borne.blade.php:410 and validation.blade.php:79. Continues the pattern flagged in round-4's regression_sweep (six commits touching borne.blade.php that round, now a seventh) — confirms the concurrent-session churn on this exact file is ongoing, but this commit is content-adjacent (carousel emptiness + font sizing), not touching the QR/logo/decode surface this audit is scoped to, and does not regress any of the 4 qr-logo spec assertions (still 4/4 green, see regression_sweep).
